items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And in my early days I used to argue about Ellington and tell the guys that Duke was the greatest... but then other guys would argue right with me that Lunceford was the greatest.

ctx.x: What did he have to say about Jimmie Lunceford? Did he talk about him?

Yes. When Lunceford died my father was in the hospital at that point, you know, and he was sick himself. He said, "I taught -- James was a very nice boy." This was before Lunceford went to Fisk University. And my father was teaching at Le Moine College in Memphis at that point, you know. It was all in Tennessee. And he said he was a very nice student, very good student. Because Lunceford had a lot of class, you know.
Did they ever stay in touch or did your father ever see him later?
